Things are heating up on HotMakes this week as we're joined by BlaznPrintz, a maker who decided 3D printing wasn't enough of a rabbit hole and started collecting other ways to turn hot noodle into cool stuff.

iD6PcHnXd9c.title: #HotMakes Ep 225 - Snakes on a Print Bed w/ Raki-Box!
iD6PcHnXd9c.description:
Things are getting a little cold-blooded on HotMakes this week as we're joined by Raki-Box, the creators turning ordinary filament into an entire zoo of suspiciously realistic reptiles and other critters!

From articulated snakes and chameleons to crocodiles and creatures that look like they might actually bite you, Raki-Box has mastered the art of making plastic animals look a little TOO alive.

We'll dig into the design process, the science behind capturing realistic animal anatomy, and what happens when a lifelong reptile obsession meets 3D printing. Because apparently owning a few reptiles wasn't enough. Now we have to manufacture them.

No animals were harmed in the making of this episode. Filament, however, is another story.

We’re diving into Joey’s latest obsession: a custom drawer app inspired by Jerrari3D’s GEN2 modular storage system. Yes, we are doing software for drawers now. This is who we are.

3D printed organization, grilled glizzys,, and convention drama. A very normal episode, honestly.
